newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ cuts prime rate to 9.85 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ cuts prime rate to 9.85 pct.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said it will cut its Australian business reference (prime) rate to 9.85 percent from 10.35 percent, effective December 16.
The bank said it will also reduce its business index rate to 10.25 percent from 10.75 percent on the same date.
The bank said the cuts were in response to the 50 point reduction in official cash rates to 6.5 percent announced by the Reserve Bank early on Wednesday.
The ANZ was the first of the major banks to announce a cut in business lending rates on Wednesday.
It earlier announced a 50 point reduction in its standard variable home loan rate to 8.75 percent from 9.25 percent.
